_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with NVIDIA's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (NVDA listed 1999-01-22)

pit_profile.why: 'NVIDIA Corporation helped awaken the world to the power of computer graphics when it invented the graphics processor unit, or GPU, in 1999.' 'The market for our products is intensely competitive and is characterized by rapid technological change, evolving industry standards and declining average selling prices.' 'Additionally, Intel and AMD have each announced its intention to integrate a central processing unit, or CPU, and a GPU on the same chip or same package, as evidenced by AMD’s announcement of its Fusion processor project and Intel’s announcement of its multichip packaged solution codenamed Arrandale.' 'Our business is cyclical in nature and has experienced severe downturns that have, and may in the future, materially adversely affect our business and financial results.' (FY2010 10-K); CYCLICAL on the 10-K's own words for its business (BKR's 'Our business is cyclical' reading); no theme in taxonomy_eras.json covers a CPU and a GPU integrated on one chip, so those words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -64.3%/yr (worst year FY01-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -12.2%/yr (Q4 FY11 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY09 ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +30.2%/yr (FY01-FY08 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +147.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY01-FY08, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NVDA (retrospective, 2010-12-17) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.13x (84.5% downside to Bear $2.23 / +663.2% upside to Bull $109.67) | Adj composite 2.35 vs market 1.00: gap +1.35 [UNDERVALUED] | -39% above the EPP floor $23.58 (18x FY11E $1.31) | Conservative 2-yr case: +155.3% total (+77.6%/yr) | At 11.0x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $19.00 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue -6.6% YoY in Q3 FY11, forward revenues -11.5% to -9.8% (Q4 FY11 revenue guide (Q3 FY11 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
